subject: Automotive & EVs
title: Euro NCAP Raises the Bar
description: A short lesson to help you apply Euro NCAP Raises the Bar.

hook.text: When European cars scored well on US tests, engineers began to wonder if the tests were too easy.

buildup.text: In 1997, Europe launched Euro NCAP with tougher tests and stricter scoring systems.

discovery.text: Euro NCAP added pedestrian protection and child safety—not just adult occupant survival.

twist.text: Some cars with five US stars scored poorly in Europe, exposing gaps in American testing.

climax.text: Euro NCAP now tests for automatic braking, cyclist detection, and driver monitoring.

punchline.text: Europe asked harder questions and cars got safer globally.

quiz.question: What did Euro NCAP add that US tests initially lacked?
